## Why This Is Asked

- OTCA telemetry and real-time analytics

## Code Example

```python
# Pseudo-code: per-tenant Z-score anomaly in streaming job
for event in stream:  # event contains tenant_id, latency_ms, timestamp
  stats = tenant_stats[tenant_id]
  z = (event.latency_ms - stats.mean) / (stats.std or 1)
  if z > 3:
    emit_alert(tenant_id, event.timestamp, event.latency_ms)
```
